age.evidence: Male C57BL/6 J mice, 9-10 weeks old, were purchased from JAX labs

sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6 J mice, 9-10 weeks old

dosing.evidence: 2.5 mg/kg 1-(2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodophenyl)-2-aminopropane (DOI; Sigma)... DOI and SER-082 were dissolved in saline... DOI was administered intraperitoneally (IP)

25CN-NBOH was dissolved in water containing 1% Tween 80. 25CN-NBOH and SER-082 were administered subcutaneously (SC)... mice were treated with vehicle or with one of 5 doses of 25CN-NBOH (0.3, 1, 3, 10, 30 mg/kg) 10 min before testing

handling.evidence: Methods do not mention a pre-test handling protocol.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in standard cages (28.4 × 18.4 × 12.5 cm) in an individually ventilated caging system with corncob bedding.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Mice were housed on a 12 h:12 h reversed light-dark cycle (lights off at 7:00 am)

enrichment_housing.evidence: Mice were housed in standard cages... with corncob bedding (no enrichment items mentioned).

assays.assay_name: Probabilistic Spatial Discrimination and Reversal Learning (T-maze)
assays.assay_description: T-maze (36 × 12 × 12 cm arms) with 80/20 probabilistic reinforcement. Mice underwent acquisition (vehicle only), then 24 h later retention followed immediately by reversal under drug. Measures: trials to criterion (acquisition, retention, reversal), perseverative errors, regressive errors.

application_type.evidence: DOI was administered intraperitoneally (IP)... 25CN-NBOH and SER-082 were administered subcutaneously (SC)

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were first trained to navigate the maze, followed by probabilistic spatial acquisition learning and reversal learning.

setup_restrain.evidence: the guillotine door was raised by the experimenter, allowing the animal to freely navigate both choice arms

food_restriction.evidence: mice were food restricted and maintained at 85% of their ad lib body weight

time_to_assay.evidence: Preinjection times were 30 min (SER-082), 20 min (DOI), and 20 min (25CN-NBOH) prior to the reversal learning phase.

sample_size.evidence: Mice were injected with vehicle (n = 17), 2.5 mg/kg DOI (n = 8), 1.0 mg/kg SER-082 (n = 8), SER-082/DOI (n = 9), or 1.0 mg/kg 25CN-NBOH (n = 9).

outcomes.summary: 25CN-NBOH (1 mg/kg) and the SER-082/DOI combination significantly increased trials to criterion during reversal learning compared to vehicle; DOI alone or SER-082 alone did not. The SER-082/DOI group made more perseverative errors, while the 25CN-NBOH group made more regressive errors. Acquisition and retention did not differ across groups.
outcomes.statistics: Reversal trials-to-criterion: F(4,46)=3.77, p<0.05. Perseverative errors: F(4,46)=3.47, p<0.05. Regressive errors: F(4,46)=5.24, p<0.01. Acquisition: F(4,46)=1.55, NS. Retention: F(4,46)=0.53, NS.
outcomes.evidence: Mice treated with SER-DOI combination or 1.0 mg/kg of 25CN-NBOH required more trials to reach criterion compared to vehicle treated mice (p<0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: trials to criterion on acquisition, retention, reversal; perseverative errors; regressive errors

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Outcomes reported as totals per session; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Errors classified by phase (perseverative vs regressive) but no sequential/transition or Markov analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measures are arm choices in an operant-like task, not natural ethological acts.

B5_social.evidence: Mice were tested alone in the T-maze.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Probabilistic spatial discrimination and reversal learning task.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The initial arm choice was recorded for each trial (manual scoring).

B8_multivariate.evidence: Separate one-way ANOVAs were conducted for each measure.

E1_environment_type.evidence: T-maze with equal sized arms... made of back Plexiglas

E2_shelter.evidence: T-maze arms are open with a start area closed only by a guillotine door; no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: Maze made of Plexiglas; cleaned with 10% alcohol between trials; no bedding described.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the maze.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: T-maze with start area and two choice arms separated by walls and guillotine/sliding doors.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was tested individually in the T-maze.

E8_food_water.evidence: Food wells located at the end of both choice arms were baited with a ½ piece of Fruity Pebbles cereal.

D1_continuity.evidence: Training across 2 consecutive days; acquisition; reversal learning was tested 24 h after acquisition testing, preceded by retention trials.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Training over 2 consecutive days, acquisition, then reversal tested 24 h later.

D4_baseline.evidence: Mice first completed retention trials immediately before reversal trials to be certain that mice began reversal trials with similar recall of the originally learned discrimination.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing began 20-30 min after drug administration; no recordings ≥24 h post-dose.

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions were 15 min; no session ≥6 h.

assays.assay_description: Photobeam-based BPM (30 × 60 cm holeboard floor in ventilated outer box). Mice tested for 60 min, with distance travelled analysed in six 10-min blocks across five doses of 25CN-NBOH plus vehicle.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were acclimated to the testing room for 60 min prior to a 60 min session in the BPM (room habituation only, not apparatus exposure).

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moved in the 30 × 60 cm holeboard arena.

food_restriction.evidence: No food was placed in the BPM during the 60-min recording session.

water_restriction.evidence: No water was placed in the BPM during the 60-min recording session.

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were treated with vehicle or with one of 5 doses of 25CN-NBOH (0.3, 1, 3, 10, 30 mg/kg) 10 min before testing

outcomes.summary: 25CN-NBOH dose-dependently affected locomotor activity: 10 and 30 mg/kg significantly reduced distance travelled vs vehicle, whereas 0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg had no effect. This confirms that the 1 mg/kg dose used in reversal learning did not impair locomotion.
outcomes.evidence: treatment with 10 or 30 mg/kg 25CN-NBOH significantly reduced locomotor activity compared to vehicle-treated mice. However, 25CN-NBOH at 1.0 mg/kg... did not significantly alter locomotor activity

B1_num_measures.evidence: Distance travelled was the sole reported behavioural measure.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Mean distance travelled in six 10-min blocks; main effect of 10-min time block F(4,281)=73.06, p<0.01.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor activity via beam breaks, not ethological acts.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Photobeam position tracking only; no pose-estimation or ML classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Two-way ANOVA on a single measure; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: 30 × 60 cm holeboard floor enclosed in a ventilated outer box.

E3_bedding.evidence: Bare holeboard floor; no bedding described.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in BPM during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: a 60 min session in the BPM

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline session reported for BPM.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing 10 min post-dose; no ≥24 h follow-up.

judge_notes: Two assays retained: (1) probabilistic T-maze reversal learning (collapses acquisition, retention, reversal phases per rubric), (2) BPM locomotor activity. Candidates agreed on assay set.
B1 for reversal scored 2 (4-6): trials-to-criterion for acquisition, retention, reversal, plus perseverative and regressive errors = 5 distinct measures.
D2 for reversal set to 15-60 min based on explicit '15 min session' statement; gptoss's 'low' confidence override rejected because the paper does state session length.
food_restriction in reversal scored 'before' (chronic body-weight maintenance at 85%) — preferred over 'during'/'no' per rubric guidance.
E8 for reversal = Yes because cereal food rewards were physically present in the apparatus during recording.
doi inferred from journal/year (Behavioural Brain Research, 2020) — kept as common candidate identifier.
